description: Locaties bruggen Gent is a dataset listed in Open Data Portaal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Dienst Wegen Bruggen en Waterlopen Gent. Deze dataset geeft alle bruggen weer op het Gentse grondgebied. Coverage: Ghent. The portal files it under Mobiliteit. Its keywords are Wegen. The portal shows 276 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Modellicentie Gratis Hergebruik (https://www.vlaanderen.be/digitaal-vlaanderen/onze-oplossingen/open-data/voorwaarden-voor-het-hergebruik-van-overheidsinformatie/modellicentie-gratis-hergebruik). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-stad-gent-portal.
